model_annotation: The diagram represents the distribution of assessments regarding the preparedness and qualifications of executors/project participants for the construction of passive houses, comparing four categories. There are a total of 4 sectors in the pie chart. The sectors are labeled as follows: "Done well and good qualifications for projects according to standards" is colored purple and accounts for 23%; "Only a small part of the executors/project participants are well trained" is colored red and accounts for 3%; "Only a small part of the projects/ executors are compliant with the standards Passive House" is colored beige and accounts for 23%; and "Done inadequately" is colored green and accounts for 51%. The chart includes a legend and percentage labels within each sector. The sectors appear to be arranged with the largest sector first.
